name: Wordsmith
author: artemisa81
description: Rewrite the text you have selected — Outlook drafts, replies, anything — with Codex running on your existing ChatGPT plan. Select, press a key, read the result, paste.

barWidget.description: Rewrite selected text in five modes, review it against the original with anything still to fill in highlighted, and paste.

schema.label: Default mode
schema.description: The mode SUPER+ALT+E uses. The others are one keypress away in the panel. Custom is excluded here because it needs an instruction typed first.

schema.label: Model
schema.description: Which model does the rewriting. All of these bill against your ChatGPT plan, not an API key. Latency is dominated by startup rather than model size, so the larger ones cost you very little time.

schema.label: Reasoning effort
schema.description: Rewriting a paragraph does not need deliberation. Your own codex config runs xhigh, which turns an 8-second rewrite into minutes — this widget ignores that config on purpose.

schema.label: Where to read the text from
schema.description: Auto takes your drag-selection when there is one and falls back to the clipboard. Choose clipboard if you would rather always press Ctrl+C first.

schema.label: Never rewrite quoted threads
schema.description: Split a quoted chain (From:, -----Original Message-----, >) off your draft, keep it out of the request entirely, and reattach it byte for byte. Off means a colleague's quoted words get reworded under their name.

schema.label: Copy the result automatically
schema.description: Put the rewrite on the clipboard the moment it is ready, so the whole gesture ends at Ctrl+V. This does overwrite whatever you had copied.

schema.label: Notify when ready
schema.description: A rewrite takes a few seconds, which is long enough to look away. Worth leaving on.

schema.label: Timeout (seconds)
schema.description: Abandon a rewrite that has not finished in this long.

schema.label: Maximum selection (characters)
schema.description: Refuse selections larger than this, so a stray Ctrl+A does not send an entire mailbox to the model.
